domains.name: Point 1: Understand user needs
domains.description: Research and understand user needs, and provide evidence that those needs are met throughout the service

domains.name: Point 2: Solve a whole problem
domains.description: Solve the whole problem for users, working across organisational boundaries

domains.name: Point 3: Provide a joined-up experience
domains.description: Create a consistent, joined-up experience across all channels and services

domains.name: Point 4: Make the service simple to use
domains.description: Build a service that is simple, intuitive, and accessible to all users

domains.name: Point 5: Make sure everyone can use the service
domains.description: Meet accessibility requirements including WCAG 2.2 AA and assistive technology support

domains.name: Point 6: Have a multidisciplinary team
domains.description: Build and maintain a multidisciplinary team with the right skills and empowerment to deliver

domains.name: Point 7: Use agile methods
domains.description: Use agile methods to build and operate the service iteratively, with frequent releases

domains.name: Point 8: Iterate and improve frequently
domains.description: Continuously improve the service using data, user feedback, and performance analytics

domains.name: Point 9: Create a secure service
domains.description: Protect user data and make the service secure against threats including cyber attacks

domains.name: Point 10: Make all new source code open
domains.description: Make all new source code open and reusable where possible, under suitable licences

domains.name: Point 11: Use and contribute to open standards
domains.description: Use open standards, common platforms, and government patterns to build the service

domains.name: Point 12: Operate a reliable service
domains.description: Operate the service so it is reliable, resilient, and available to users when needed

domains.name: Point 13: Make performance data available
domains.description: Publish performance data about the service to demonstrate it is meeting user needs

domains.name: Point 14: Decide to build, buy, or reuse
domains.description: Make a considered build vs. buy decision based on value for money and long-term cost
